meta.name_en: 2009 Report of the Senior Citizen Condition Survey
meta.data_description_zh:
1. 本次調查依據統計法第 3條、第19條、老人福利法第 10條，以及內政部 98年度
施政計畫規定辦理。
2. 調查區域範圍：以臺閩地區為調查區域範圍，包括臺灣省各縣(市)、直轄市及金
馬地區(金門縣、連江縣)。
3. 調查對象：以居住於調查區域範圍內之普通住戶及共同事業戶內年滿 55歲以上之
本國籍人口為對象。(為避免代答者過多，原則上在調查期間內出國、住院、入監
獄服刑、常住寺廟、離家出走等年滿 55歲以上本國籍人口，不予訪查。)
4. 調查方法：普通住戶採電話訪問法，共同事業戶採實地訪問調查法。
(引述 98年老人狀況調查實施計畫)
meta.notes_zh:
1. 調查表分為共同問項(A表)，65歲以上者專用問項(B表)、55 至64歲者專用問項
(C 表)三種。

meta.name_zh_from_listing: 資料庫使用手冊Welfare5-98年老人狀況調查資料檔
meta.data_description_en:
1. This survey was conducted pursuant to Articles 3 and 19 of the Statistics Act, Article 10 of the Senior Citizens Welfare Act, and the Ministry of the Interior's 2009 (ROC year 98) administrative plan.
2. Survey area: the Taiwan-Fukien Area, including the counties/cities of Taiwan Province, special municipalities, and the Kinmen-Matsu Area (Kinmen County, Lienchiang County).
3. Survey subjects: Republic of China nationals aged 55 and older residing in ordinary households and collective/institutional households within the survey area. (To avoid excessive proxy responses, in principle, nationals aged 55 and older who, during the survey period, are abroad, hospitalized, imprisoned, permanently residing in a temple, or have left home are not surveyed.)
4. Survey method: telephone interviews for ordinary households, and in-person field interviews for collective/institutional households.
(Quoted from the 2009 (ROC year 98) Elderly Status Survey Implementation Plan)
meta.notes_en:
1. The questionnaire is divided into three types: common questions (Form A), questions exclusively for those aged 65 and older (Form B), and questions exclusively for those aged 55-64 (Form C).
※ This center's database has been de-identified: directly identifying fields such as name and address have been removed, and fields such as ID number, facility code, insured unit code, tax ID number, date of birth, visit date, and admission date have been masked. The data may only be used within the independent workspace established by the Ministry, and only approved aggregate statistical results may be taken out, ensuring that the data and its disclosure method can no longer identify specific individuals.
1. The key for identifying sample data: sample serial number (NEWID).
2. No ID-number key is provided.

meta.name_en: Report of the Senior Citizen Condition Survey 2013
meta.data_description_zh: 資料為102 年老人狀況調查。
meta.notes_zh:
1. 老人狀況調查於 75 年由行政院主計總處（原行政院主計處）於人力資源調查中
附帶辦理「青少年及老人狀況調查」；78 年起則改由行政院主計總處與內政部合
作辦理「老人狀況調查」，並隔年舉辦一次；84 年起移由內政部辦理，並分別於
85、89、91、94 及 98 年辦理 5 次，其間 96 年 1 月老人福利法修正，建立定
期辦理規制，102 年配合政府組織再造，本調查由內政部辦理前階段訪問作業，
衛福部完成後續整理及分析工作。
2. 本調查項目包括：蒐集年滿 55 歲以上民眾之居住狀況、就業狀況、經纃狀況、
自我照顧能力、對福利措施了解情形及對老年生活的期望與擔心問題等老人生活
福祉相關資訊，以作為研訂老人福利政策，以及加強老人服務與照顧措施之參據。
3. 調查實施計畫、抽樣設計、調查表，可參閱衛生福利部統計處網頁址：
https://dep.mohw.gov.tw/DOS/lp-5095-113.html)。
※本中心資料庫業經去識別化處理，刪除姓名、地址等可直接識別欄位，如有身分證
字號、院所代碼、投保單位代號、統一編號、出生日期、就醫日期、入院日期等欄位
均經屏蔽處理，且相關資料僅能於本部設置之獨立作業區內使用，並攜出經審核通過
之統計結果，以確保資料應用及其揭露方式已無從識別特定當事人。 無。

meta.data_description_en: The data are from the 2013 (ROC year 102) Elderly Status Survey.
meta.notes_en:
1. The Elderly Status Survey was first conducted in 1986 (ROC year 75) by the Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics, Executive Yuan (formerly the Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics) as a supplementary "Survey of Youth and Elderly Status" within the manpower survey; starting in 1989 (ROC year 78), it was renamed the "Elderly Status Survey" and conducted jointly with the Ministry of the Interior every other year; starting in 1995 (ROC year 84), it was handled by the Ministry of the Interior alone, and conducted 5 times, in 1996, 2000, 2002, 2005, and 2009 (ROC years 85, 89, 91, 94, and 98). During this period, the Senior Citizens Welfare Act was amended in January 2007 (ROC year 96), establishing a regular schedule for the survey; in 2013 (ROC year 102), in line with government reorganization, the Ministry of the Interior conducted the earlier-stage interview work while the Ministry of Health and Welfare completed the subsequent data processing and analysis.
2. The survey items include collecting information related to the welfare of the elderly among people aged 55 and older, such as living conditions, employment status, financial status, self-care ability, understanding of welfare measures, and expectations of and concerns about elderly life, to serve as a reference for formulating elderly welfare policy and strengthening elderly services and care measures.
3. The survey implementation plan, sampling design, and questionnaire can be found on the website of the Department of Statistics, Ministry of Health and Welfare: https://dep.mohw.gov.tw/DOS/lp-5095-113.html).
※ This center's database has been de-identified: directly identifying fields such as name and address have been removed, and fields such as ID number, facility code, insured unit code, tax ID number, date of birth, visit date, and admission date have been masked. The data may only be used within the independent workspace established by the Ministry, and only approved aggregate statistical results may be taken out, ensuring that the data and its disclosure method can no longer identify specific individuals. None.

meta.name_en: Report of the Senior Citizen Condition Survey 2017
meta.record_count_raw: 55歲以上：6,920 筆 主要家庭照顧者：469筆
meta.data_description_zh:
1.本調查係依據老人福利法第 10 條規定辦理，主要為蒐集我國 55 歲以上人口生活情形，本
次調查為關心家庭照顧者，另外又訪問65 歲以上無法獨立生活之主要家庭照顧者照顧相關
問項。
2.問卷分為「65歲以上」、「55-64歲」及「主要家庭照顧者」等3種。問卷內容包含：家庭及
居住狀況、健康狀況、日常生活與自我照顧能力(僅65歲以上)、就業狀況、社會活動狀況、
家庭照顧情形、經濟狀況、對老人福利措施之瞭解情形、對進住老人福利機構、老人公寓、
老人住宅、社區安養堂或護理之家的意願情形、對已進住老人福利機構、老人公寓、老人
住宅、社區安養堂或護理之家者居住情形、對老年生活的看法或感受、基本資料等；「主要
家庭照顧者」問卷內容包含：基本資料、照顧工作情形及政府提供照顧者支持服務需求。
3.本次調查共完成訪問「65歲以上」4,310人、「55-64歲」2,610人、主要家庭照顧者469人。
4. 調查實施計畫 、 抽樣設計 、 調查表 ， 可參閱衛生福利部統計處網頁 ( 網
址:https://dep.mohw.gov.tw/DOS/lp-1767-113.html)。
meta.notes_zh:
1.檔案 W_MOHW_ SeniorCitizen106 共 6,920 筆，包括「55-64 歲」(2,610 人)、「65 歲以上」
(4,310人)問卷調查結果資料。
2.檔案W_MOHW_ SeniorCitizen_carer106 為「主要家庭照顧者」問卷調查結果，係調查 65歲
以上無法獨立生活之主要家庭照顧者(469人)，為避免影響主卷之回表與調查品質，主要家
庭照顧者副卷係採由主要照顧者自願填答方式辦理，致回收樣本數有限，且分配未必與母
體一致，應用時請審慎。
※本中心資料庫業經去識別化處理，刪除姓名、地址等可直接識別欄位，如有身分證字號、
院所代碼、投保單位代號、統一編號、出生日期、就醫日期、入院日期等欄位均經屏蔽處理，
且相關資料僅能於本部設置之獨立作業區內使用，並攜出經審核通過之統計結果，以確保資
料應用及其揭露方式已無從識別特定當事人。 檔案資料比對的鍵值:樣本編號(CASEID)
meta.name_zh_from_listing: 資料庫使用手冊Welfare5-106年老人狀況調查資料檔
meta.data_description_en:
1. This survey was conducted pursuant to Article 10 of the Senior Citizens Welfare Act, mainly to collect data on the living conditions of Taiwan's population aged 55 and older. This survey focused on family caregivers, and additionally surveyed care-related questions for the primary family caregivers of persons aged 65 and older who are unable to live independently.
2. The questionnaire is divided into three types: "65 and older," "55-64," and "primary family caregiver." The content covers: family and living conditions, health status, daily living and self-care ability (65 and older only), employment status, social activity status, family caregiving conditions, economic status, understanding of elderly welfare measures, willingness to move into elderly welfare institutions, elderly apartments, elderly housing, community care centers, or nursing homes, living conditions for those already residing in such facilities, views or feelings about elderly life, and basic information, among others; the "primary family caregiver" questionnaire covers basic information, caregiving work conditions, and needs for government-provided caregiver support services.
3. This survey completed a total of 4,310 interviews for "65 and older," 2,610 for "55-64," and 469 for primary family caregivers.
4. The survey implementation plan, sampling design, and questionnaire can be found on the website of the Department of Statistics, Ministry of Health and Welfare (URL: https://dep.mohw.gov.tw/DOS/lp-1767-113.html).
meta.notes_en:
1. The file W_MOHW_SeniorCitizen106 contains a total of 6,920 records, including questionnaire results for "55-64 years old" (2,610 people) and "65 and older" (4,310 people).
2. The file W_MOHW_SeniorCitizen_carer106 contains the questionnaire results for "primary family caregivers," surveying the primary family caregivers (469 people) of persons aged 65 and older who are unable to live independently. To avoid affecting the response rate and quality of the main questionnaire, the primary-family-caregiver supplementary questionnaire was completed on a voluntary basis by the primary caregiver, resulting in a limited number of collected samples whose distribution may not match that of the population; please use this data with caution.
※ This center's database has been de-identified: directly identifying fields such as name and address have been removed, and fields such as ID number, facility code, insured unit code, tax ID number, date of birth, visit date, and admission date have been masked. The data may only be used within the independent workspace established by the Ministry, and only approved aggregate statistical results may be taken out, ensuring that the data and its disclosure method can no longer identify specific individuals. The key for matching file data: case number (CASEID)

meta.name_zh_from_listing: 資料庫使用手冊Welfare5-111年老人狀況調查資料檔
meta.data_description_en:
1. This survey was conducted pursuant to Article 10 of the Senior Citizens Welfare Act. The survey used in-person field interviews; in addition to surveying the population aged 65 and older, and following past practice, it also surveyed the population aged 55-64 (main form) in order to understand the status of the population approaching old age. This survey focused on family caregivers, and additionally surveyed the primary family caregivers (supplementary form) of persons aged 55 and older whose daily living requires assistance or care from others. This round completed 6,803 valid samples for the main form (55 and older) and 503 valid samples for the supplementary form (primary family caregivers).
2. Survey items include, for the population aged 55 and older: family and living conditions, health and self-care ability, employment and economic status, social activities, public-transportation friendliness, willingness to move into residential-care institutions and personal views, and the burden on primary family caregivers, among other data, to serve as a reference for the government in formulating elderly-related welfare policy.
3. The survey implementation plan, sampling design, and questionnaire can be found on the website of the Department of Statistics, Ministry of Health and Welfare: https://dep.mohw.gov.tw/DOS/lp-5095-113.html).
meta.notes_en:
1. The questionnaire is divided into a main form (for the case sample) and a supplementary form (for primary family caregivers). To avoid affecting the response rate and quality of the main form, the primary-family-caregiver supplementary form was completed on a voluntary basis by the primary caregiver, resulting in a limited number of collected samples whose distribution may not match that of the population; please use this data with caution.
※ This center's database has been de-identified: directly identifying fields such as name and address have been removed, and fields such as ID number, facility code, insured unit code, tax ID number, date of birth, visit date, and admission date have been masked. The data may only be used within the independent workspace established by the Ministry, and only approved aggregate statistical results may be taken out, ensuring that the data and its disclosure method can no longer identify specific individuals. The key for matching the main-form and supplementary-form file data: sample number (CASEID)
